correctness.rationale: Definitions are reconstructed from arXiv:2605.00041v1: domains are Hom(V/W,U), generators induce isomorphisms on image and quotient factors, and rectangular domains are preserved under restriction, preimage and composition. Rank-one operators realize every proper nonzero pair, and recovery from common kernel and image span proves uniqueness. Finite separate checks reproduce 11, 18 and 198 domains, the 4 and 36 binary square-zero-domain counts, and full monoid n=2 q=2 (52 maps, 11 idempotents). Tests supplement, not replace, the arbitrary-field proof.

value.rationale: Every inverse monoid has a canonical semilattice of idempotents controlling its domain structure. This is a complete infinite-family determination of that nontrivial invariant for the exact matrix-endomorphism case of an explicit open characterization problem. The two-independent-subspace coordinates and square-zero criterion reveal non-corner domains and give exact domain counts; non-idempotent structure genuinely remains open.
